headline: Revenue and EBITDA surge; GAAP profit dips on deal costs
summary_short: CACI's fiscal 2026 fourth quarter revenue rose 17.6% y/y to $2.71 billion on 11.6% organic growth, while GAAP diluted EPS slipped 1.3% to $7.05 on higher interest expense from the ARKA acquisition and a higher tax provision; adjusted diluted EPS grew 6.1% to $8.91.
summary_long: Revenue grew 17.6% y/y (11.6% organic) and 15.2% sequentially to $2.71B, with operating income up 31.7% y/y on higher revenue and gross profit. GAAP diluted EPS fell 1.3% y/y to $7.05 as increased interest expense from the ARKA acquisition and a sharply higher tax provision offset the operating gain; adjusted diluted EPS (ex-intangible amortization) rose 6.1% to $8.91. EBITDA margin expanded to 13.0% from 11.5%. Free cash flow rose 67.4% y/y to $232.9M on working-capital management. Cash was $191.8M; long-term debt (net of current) rose to $4,855M from $2,849M a year ago, reflecting ARKA financing. CACI issued FY2027 guidance: revenue $10,650-$10,850M, adjusted EPS $32.96-$33.86, free cash flow of at least $900M.
